kernel_correction.support_interpretation: Kcorr=0 can be an interpolation dummy when kernel support is insufficient; it must not be interpreted as a physical zero.

lifecycle.identity_semantics: solver numerical-node lifecycle only; not material lineage

limitations: The force CSV is a two-dimensional per-depth wall integral, not a 3-D load.
